translation.name: Xchiʼdxyi cuubi dxiohs nin bieʼgaluuʼyi daada Jesucristu (El Nuevo Testamento en el zapoteco de Chichicapan y en español)

content: Chin guhchi Jacobo bieꞌw Pehdru laꞌn lahtsidxiꞌba
Laꞌn dxyih raꞌ chi gahca trabahjw duxa batiꞌdxi rrehyi Herodes laꞌh raꞌ spaaldaa xpwiinn Jesucristu.
Gunabwaꞌ Herodes guhchi Jacobo bwihtsi Jwahn cun spahda,

ya coma bwaꞌha Herodes niꞌchi riuuꞌstoꞌ raꞌ bwiinn Israel gudxiinn ba laꞌh Jacobo, niꞌchin gunabwaꞌ ba binaꞌzu Pehdru bieꞌw laꞌn lahtsidxiꞌba. Deeꞌ guhca laꞌn dxyih lañih raꞌ chin rahw raꞌ ba pahn nin ayi rahcachaꞌyi cun levadura.

Chin binaꞌzu Pehdru bieꞌw ba laꞌn lahtsidxiꞌba, ya gunabwaꞌ Herodes bieꞌw ba hastayi riiyahpaa tahpa cwaꞌh suldahdu, ya tahpagah suldahdu chi cada tuhbigah cwaꞌh raꞌ ba. Bwiꞌhnn Herodes lligaaba cweꞌhe ba laꞌh Pehdru laꞌn lahtsidxiꞌba chi tin gutiꞌdxi ba Pehdru loh raꞌ bwiinn Israel chin tiidxi lañih tin gusaꞌcazii raꞌ ba laꞌh ba nicala ayi xi bwiꞌhnn ba.
Ya ziꞌchi zi cayahpaadziꞌtsi raꞌ ba Pehdru laꞌn lahtsidxiꞌba, per garaatiiꞌ raꞌ xpwiinn Jesucristu gwazahtiiꞌ mahziru cabwihdxyi-canaaba raꞌ ba loh Dxiohs pur xcweenta Pehdru.
Babweꞌhe Dxiohs laꞌh Pehdru laꞌn lahtsidxiꞌba

Ñarah gueꞌla chi ñibweꞌhe raꞌ ba Pehdru delaanta loh raꞌ bwiinn Israel. Per gueꞌla chi naꞌllgahsi Pehdru galaayi chiohpa suldahdu ya dziꞌtsi nayiꞌbi ba cun chiohpa cadehn, ya xchiohpa suldahdu chi riiyahpaa rwaaꞌ lahtsidxiꞌba.

Seguihdu baluuꞌyiloh tuhbi aanjla Dxiohs laꞌn lahtsidxiꞌba neezaa baziaꞌñih tuhbi bwehla riꞌchi, ya chiꞌchi bariꞌh aanjla chi laꞌh Pehdru tin babahn ba, chiꞌchi rahbi ba: ―Guenagah gwastii. Chiꞌchi dxyiigah billaachi raꞌ cadehn nin bachiꞌbi raꞌ ba laꞌh Pehdru,

chiꞌchi rahbi aanjla chi loh Pehdru: ―Bachiꞌbiduꞌh xtuꞌdxihdxi luꞌh laꞌntihxi luꞌh, bacaꞌh tahba luꞌh ñaaꞌ luꞌh. Ziꞌchi bwiꞌhnn Pehdru, chiꞌchi rahbi aanjla Dxiohs loh Pehdru: ―Guhta xahba luꞌh tin gudaꞌnaꞌhla naꞌh.
Bariaꞌh chiꞌh Pehdru laꞌn lahtsidxiꞌba naꞌhlagah ba laꞌh aanjla Dxiohs, per cayuhnn ba lligaaba pweda xcaꞌldazi ba cañiꞌxihn.

Ya badiiꞌdxi raꞌ ba hasta zuu tuhbi suldahdu nin cayahpaa lwehgu badiiꞌdxi raꞌ ba hasta zuu nin raroopa gwaardia chi ya seguihdu badzihn raꞌ ba rwaaꞌ pweerta dxiꞌba nin caa loh neziuh lwehgu yuꞌpisin billaalan bariaꞌh raꞌ ba, ya guzah raꞌ ba tuhbi calle chi ya dxyigahsi guñihchiloh xaanjla Dxiohs loh Pehdru.

Chiꞌchiyi guhcabwaꞌ Pehdru, rahbi ba: ―Nnahsihn laꞌn guhcabwaꞌ Dxiohs guxeꞌhla xaanjla Ñiꞌh tin bieꞌgataꞌh Ñiꞌh naꞌh lahtsinaa Herodes tin adxi guunn raꞌ bwiinn Israel nin luꞌh riiyuhnn raꞌ ba lligaaba guunnee raꞌ ba naꞌh.

Yaque gwachiistoꞌ Pehdru nin guzahca ba chiꞌchi gwah ba rwaaꞌ yihdzi María xnaan Jwahn nin rñiꞌ raꞌ ba Marcu. Riꞌchi rii raꞌ ziahan raꞌ xpwiinn Jesucristu tin cabwihdxyi-canaaba raꞌ ba loh Dxiohs xcweenta Pehdru.
Ya chin basiꞌdzi Pehdru rwaaꞌ pweerta nin caa rwaaꞌ leeꞌ, chiꞌchi biriaꞌh tuhbi dxaꞌpa nin laa Rode zeguiaꞌha bi chyuuñin.
Ya chin bihn bi rsiaaꞌ Pehdru, biahxi duxa bi ya biaꞌldastoꞌ bi ñuxaala bi rwaaꞌ leeꞌ ñuuꞌtii Pehdru, mahzi bwiꞌhnn bi pur gwaguihtsii bi loh raꞌ nin rii laꞌn ñuuꞌ, rahbi bi: ―¡Pehdru zuu rwaaꞌ leeꞌ!
Chiꞌchi rahbi raꞌ ba loh Rode: ―Cayahca naxihn yihca luꞌh. Ya laꞌh bi ya guluuꞌbwaꞌ bi Pehdru niꞌchi, ya laꞌh raꞌ ba rahbi raꞌ ba: ―Pweda xaanjla Dxiohs nin rahcanee laꞌh Pehdrun.
Ya zeezah cagasiꞌdzi Pehdru rwaaꞌ leeꞌ, ya chin guxaala raꞌ ba rwaaꞌ leeꞌ badxyigaaꞌ duxa raꞌ ba chin bwaꞌha raꞌ ba laꞌh Pehdru.

Chiꞌchi bazaꞌbinaa Pehdru tin ayiru guiñiꞌ raꞌ ba tin gucaꞌdxiahga raꞌ ba nin guzahca ba, chiꞌchi bwiiꞌyidxyiꞌdxyi Pehdru xa babweꞌhe xaanjla Dxiohs laꞌh ba laꞌn lahtsidxiꞌba. Chiꞌchi rahbi Pehdru loh raꞌ ba: ―Gulcheguihtsii loh Jacobo cun loh raꞌ lasaaꞌ nuꞌh nin naa raꞌ xpwiinn Jesucristu garaa nin guzaꞌcaꞌhn nnah gueꞌla. Chiꞌchi bariaꞌh Pehdru riꞌchi tin zee ba stuhbi lahta.
Chin barah gueꞌla, rsiiyidoꞌ gacaru, biahyi duxa raꞌ suldahdu laasii ayi gaann raꞌ ba xa guhca bariaꞌh Pehdru laꞌn lahtsidxiꞌba.

Ya gunabwaꞌ Herodes badxiꞌhyi raꞌ suldahdu laꞌh Pehdru, ya bwaꞌhazi ba ayi badxeela Pehdru, chiꞌchi gunabwaꞌ guhchi raꞌ suldahdu nin guriiyahpaa rwaaꞌ lahtsidxiꞌba hasta bieꞌw Pehdru. Ya seguihdu biriaꞌh Herodes guihdxyi Judea tin gwahguiꞌhnn lahdxyi ba guihdxyi Cesarea.
Guhchi Herodes

Neezaa rdxyiꞌchinee Herodes laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn guihdxyi Tiru cun bwiinn guihdxyi Sidohn laꞌn dxyih raꞌ chi ya bwiinn raꞌ chi batiaaꞌha lasaaꞌ raꞌ ba tin gwagañiꞌnee raꞌ ba laꞌh ba, ya bwiꞌhnn raꞌ ba gahn, laasii guñiꞌ tuhbi ndxiꞌhw nin laa Blastu pur laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn guihdxyi raꞌ chi. Ndxiꞌhw chi naa tuhbi nin mahzi rahpaa laꞌh Herodes, ya ndxiꞌhw Blastu chi gunaaba cwidxyiistoꞌ Herodes cun bwiinn guihdxyi raꞌ chi laasii lahdxyi Herodes naa hasta rdooꞌ xi rahw raꞌ ba.

Ya tuhbi dxyih nin biaꞌhandxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ ba guuꞌyidxyiꞌdxyinee Herodes laꞌh raꞌ ba. Dxyih chi guhta Herodes xabarrehyi ba tin guzohba ba loh yagaxiiyi hasta ruhnn ba guelguxchisi nee guñiꞌza ba mahs paaldaa dxyiꞌdxyi nezloh garaa raꞌ bwiinn raꞌ chi.
Ya chiꞌchi guzoꞌbaloh cañiꞌ jweersi bwiinn raꞌ chi squiiꞌ: ―¡Per nin cañiꞌ loh nu rii ayi bwiinn dxiꞌh ba, Dxiohsan! ―rahbi raꞌ ba.
Hohr chi gahca biehta tuhbi aanjla Dxiohs, bwiꞌhnn ba guzoꞌbaloh cayahcalluꞌhu Herodes, gudahw bizuhga laꞌh Herodes ya ziꞌchi guhchi ba laasii basaaꞌn ba guñiꞌ raꞌ bwiinn naa ba Dxiohs.
Ya zeezah cadiꞌchii duxa xchiꞌdxyi Jesucristu garaatiiꞌ guihdxyi raꞌ ziꞌchiza zeedahla duxa raꞌza xpwiinn Jesucristu.
Chin guyaꞌloh dziꞌn nin bwiꞌhnn Bernabeh cun Saulu, gubiaꞌgarii raꞌ ba guihdxyi Jerusalehn cun tuhbi lasaaꞌ raꞌ ba nin rñiꞌ raꞌ ba Marcu.
